bullets.text: India HRC +4% WoW to Rs61.8K/t (+7% since July-end); spot spreads expanded ~5%, now up ~36% from mid-December lows.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley — PULSE: India Steel Tracker

bullets.text: Australian HCC met coal +3% WoW to ~US$278/t (+28% MoM) on Shanxi disruptions; domestic HRC now only ~1% below import parity.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley — PULSE: India Steel Tracker

bullets.text: GS cut 2027E China steel earnings 14-41% on lower unit profit; margins seen staying depressed through 2H26 with limited supply discipline.
bullets.source: Goldman Sachs — GS Sales Note: China commodity 1H26 earnings reviews (Trina Chen)

bullets.text: Copper's price spike is pushing Indian appliance makers to substitute aluminium in entry-level ACs, refrigerators and fans, with localisation accelerating.
bullets.source: Nomura — India Consumer Durables and EMS daily

bullets.text: China 1H26 aluminium margins rose on elevated prices though copper/aluminium results mostly missed; GS keeps Sell on Chalco, Buy on Zijin/CMOC.
bullets.source: Goldman Sachs — GS Sales Note: China commodity 1H26 earnings reviews (Trina Chen)

bullets.text: UltraTech launched 'Ultravolt' W&C on 3 Sep with a Rs1,800cr bet, debuting No.2 in wires by capacity, targeting top-2 within 3-5 years.
bullets.source: Kotak — UltraTech W&C launch: unveils ambitious target to be within top-2 players in 3-5 years

bullets.text: BofA keeps UltraTech BUY, PO Rs13,400: Ultravolt launch ahead of plan, with 2HFY27 cost trajectory the key driver for the stock.
bullets.source: BofA — UTCEM: 'Ultravolt' launch ahead of plan; BUY

bullets.text: JPM reads UTCEM's launch as a sentiment negative for Polycab but sees meaningful business impact as unlikely.
bullets.source: JPMorgan — Polycab: UTCEM's official launch a sentiment negative (+4 more in Outlook)

bullets.text: China CFR iron ore (61% Fe) +1% WoW to ~US$99/t; NMDC domestic prices at ~52% discount to parity versus ~56% 5-year average.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley — PULSE: India Steel Tracker

bullets.text: GS post-1H26 reshuffle: Zhaojin cut to Neutral, GEM to Sell; Ganfeng-H and Huayou upgraded to Neutral; coal still favoured on solid demand.
bullets.source: Goldman Sachs — GS Sales Note: China commodity 1H26 earnings reviews (Trina Chen)

bullets.text: Nomura raises Avalon TP to Rs2,767 (23% upside, Buy) on the Zollner JV, adding EU healthcare/T&M verticals and a ~21% FY29F EPS boost.
bullets.source: Nomura — Avalon Technologies: Zollner JV to expand into advanced EMS in EU

bullets.text: Zollner (~US$3.7bn revenue; supplies BMW, Bosch, Teradyne) holds 51% initially, Avalon can take majority after three years; total investment ~US$30-50mn.
bullets.source: Avendus Spark — To Put it Briefly: Avalon announces manufacturing JV with Zollner Elektronik AG

bullets.text: Commodity squeeze bites EMS/durables: PG Electroplast's cost to build 500k ACs is up ~34% YoY (Rs700cr to Rs940cr), margins now single-digit.
bullets.source: Nomura — India Consumer Durables and EMS daily

bullets.text: CLSA lifts Nvidia TP to US$425 from US$360, FY27-29 EPS up 9-19% on Rubin pricing; ASIC threat called overblown, sovereign AI now 20% of revenue.
bullets.source: CLSA (Bhavtosh Vajpayee) — Nvidia: The biggest questions

bullets.text: Aug-26 India IT deal wins stayed muted m-m; Europe strong, BFSI zero announcements; Infosys led with 3 wins, TCS 2 plus Porsche's MHP acquisition.
bullets.source: BNP Paribas (Kumar Rakesh) — India Quick Notes: IT Services deal wins muted

bullets.text: Persistent shares fell on board-approved $1.25bn fundraise; Hexaware names Vivek Jetley CEO-designate; TCS wins METRO AG and stc Bahrain deals.
bullets.source: Kotak — Technology News Wrap Sep 04 (+4 more in Outlook)

bullets.text: Rs10tn (4% of NDTL) liquidity surplus from $127bn FCNR(B) inflows; RBI expected to absorb Rs7-8tn via flexible VRRRs, sell/buy swaps, CRR hikes, OMO sales.
bullets.source: CLSA (Nikhil Gupta) — India Economics: Problem of plenty

bullets.text: Multi-quarter growth upcycle call: overweight Financials, Consumer Discretionary, Industrials; underweight Energy, Materials, Utilities, Healthcare; de-rating judged cyclical, IT services a dark horse on AI.
bullets.source: Morgan Stanley (Ridham Desai) — India Equity Strategy Playbook: A Long Way Up

bullets.text: $3.2bn August FII inflows (highest since Sep-2024) masked $1.4bn primary-market skew; FIIs bypassing Financials/IT (44% of Nifty), Nifty still 8.2% below January highs.
bullets.source: BNPP — Weekly Sales Thoughts: FII Inflows vs Index Divergence (+6 more in Outlook)

bullets.text: Kotak upgrades NTPC to ADD, FV Rs355 vs CMP Rs331, on inexpensive valuations.
bullets.source: Kotak — NTPC: Upgrade to ADD on inexpensive valuations

bullets.text: United Breweries investor day splits the street — Spark BUY TP Rs1,610, Elara Accumulate TP Rs1,500, Kotak SELL FV Rs1,275 — on double-digit growth, low-teen margin guidance.
bullets.source: Avendus Spark / Elara / Kotak — United Breweries analyst-meet takeaways (3 mails)

bullets.text: India CV volumes +25% YTD and FY27 seen +10-12%; BofA says Buy Ashok Leyland and Tata Motors CV at sub-20x PE.
bullets.source: BofA — India CVs: Macro fears, Micro beat. Buy AL & TMCV (+8 more in Outlook)

ai_semis.text: Semis rallied against the tape: SOX +3.3% (AMD +3.2%, TSMC ADR +2.4%, Nvidia +1.7%) while the S&P 500 fell 0.4%.
CLSA raises Nvidia FY27-29 EPS 9-19% and TP to US$425 from US$360, calling the ASIC threat overblown; sovereign AI now 20% of revenue.
ai_semis.source: CLSA broker mail — Nvidia (NVDA US): The biggest questions

ai_semis.text: US enterprise AI adoption rose to 22.4% in August per GS tracker; GS macro desk separately argues AI capex is now driving US rates higher.
ai_semis.source: Goldman Sachs broker mails — AI Adoption Tracker Aug-26; The Macro Call
